versions.name: Camp Falling Rock

features.note: A natural rock rappelling site alongside a 40-foot climbing and rappelling wall.
Foothills of the Frontier, for first-year Scouts.
The Frontier programme, for older campers and adults.

versions.summary: Simon Kenton Council Scouts BSA resident camp on more than 600 acres, located about 11 miles north of Newark, Ohio.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by a unit that attended 2026-08-13 (submission bZYBBPo), kept anonymous at submitter request. Camp Falling Rock is primarily a Scouts BSA resident camp; the Cub program there is the Daybreak District Cub Scout day camp, so cub_resident was corrected to cub_day.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
